constructorArgs.note: informational only, per contract comment -- see docs/registered-agents.json subregistry

approver.role: throwaway keypair standing in for the future Ledger-controlled key
approver.ethBalance: 0 -- verified before and after the demo; approveWithSignature() never requires the approver to hold gas
approver.note: private key lives in contracts/.env (gitignored) as LEDGER_STANDIN_PRIVATE_KEY. Swap to a real Ledger by calling PermissionGate.setApprover(realLedgerAddress) -- see docs/ledger-integration.md.

gatedResolver.note: fresh PermissionedResolver whose ONLY writer role holder is the PermissionGate contract itself -- not even the operator wallet can write to it directly. Deployed separately from the agent's live resolver (docs/registered-agents.json) so this demo never touches production agent state.

demoRun.flow: operator requests -> action PENDING, nothing written -> approver signs EIP-712 Approval(actionId) completely offline, zero ETH -> operator relays approveWithSignature() -> resolver write executes atomically with the approval

hardwareStatus: Not yet run against a physical Ledger device or the Speculos emulator (neither was available in this session -- no Docker installed, no device connected). scripts/ledger-approve.ts implements the real device-management-kit + node-hid + device-signer-kit-ethereum path per docs/ledger-integration.md, ready to run once hardware is available; it produces the identical {domain, types, message} this demo already proved end to end on chain.
